trends.headline: Pacific Wheel is packed after 6
trends.snippet: Ferris wheel line wrapping the arcade. Sunset slot is a 40-minute wait and nobody is leaving.

trends.headline: Third Street buskers vs. the speakers
trends.snippet: A saxophone, a Bluetooth speaker, and a mime. Saturday night as designed.

trends.headline: Bike path southbound is a parade
trends.snippet: Ocean Park to Venice is bumper-to-bumper on two wheels. Walk the sand instead.

trends.headline: Montana Ave brunch overflow
trends.snippet: Sidewalk tables full by 10. If you wanted a quiet coffee, you picked the wrong avenue.

trends.headline: Palisades Park is doing the postcard
trends.snippet: Sky going peach over the pier. Bring a jacket. Marine layer already rolling in.

trends.headline: E Line into Downtown SM
trends.snippet: Metro E Line terminus at 4th and Colorado. Big Blue Bus on Ocean and Olympic.

seed.name: Pier Watch
seed.text: Pacific Wheel lit up and the line is already around the arcade. If you want the sunset gondola, get here before the sky goes peach.

seed.name: Promenade Sax
seed.text: Third Street is three buskers deep tonight. Saxophone winning until the Bluetooth speaker showed up. Classic Promenade.

seed.name: Montana Brunch
seed.text: Montana Ave at 10am is a contact sport. I waited for a table, then watched three strollers claim the sidewalk. Still the best cortado in SAMO.

seed.name: Ocean Park Kid
seed.text: Ocean Park is quiet until Main Street wakes up. Walked to the sand with a coffee. Would not trade the bungalow for a high-rise.

seed.name: Path Cruiser
seed.text: Bike path southbound is a parade from the pier to Venice. E-bikes doing 20, tourists doing 4. I hopped onto the sand. Faster.

seed.name: Palisades Light
seed.text: Palisades Park at golden hour. Sky going from peach to that last teal over the water. Jacket weather already. This is the whole personality.

seed.name: Expo Rider
seed.text: E Line stalled at 26th. Hopped the Big Blue Bus on Olympic. Downtown SM in twelve minutes and I still beat the train.

seed.name: Main Street Late
seed.text: Main Street after 9 is all patio lights and the walk home to Ocean Park. Venice is loud. We are not.
